text:
Aj Chen: Heads-up — we have an onboarding call tomorrow with a customer wanting a Private/VPC sizing guide. They expect ~100 qps (avg ~50 tokens/resp), streaming enabled, per-customer isolation. Need a concise node/rack recommendation + GPU-hours/month estimate by EOD.
Mayra Lopez: Which model family? 70B vs 13B changes everything. Also ask if they can accept quantized weights.
Aj Chen: They said primary is Llama-70B but would consider quantized 4-bit if we recommend. Also embeddings workload ~30% of traffic.
Samir Patel: Quick back-of-envelope numbers below — want to sanity-check.
Samir Patel: ```
Assumptions:
- Target: 100 qps * 50 tokens = 5,000 tokens/sec
- Model perf (est):
  * Llama-70B quant4: ~200 tok/s per A100-80GB
  * Llama-70B fp16: ~60 tok/s per A100-80GB
  * 13B quant4: ~900 tok/s per A100-80GB
Sizing:
- If 70B quant4: GPUs = 5000 / 200 = 25 GPUs
- If 70B fp16: GPUs = 5000 / 60 ≈ 84 GPUs
- If 13B quant4: GPUs = 5000 / 900 ≈ 6 GPUs
GPU-hours/month (30d):
- 25 GPUs * 24 * 30 = 18,000 GPU-hours
- 84 GPUs * 24 * 30 = 60,480 GPU-hours
- 6 GPUs * 24 * 30 = 4,320 GPU-hours
Notes:
- Embeddings are more CPU/NIC-bound if batched; estimate +15% capacity for embedding traffic
- Add ~20% headroom for spikes and maintenance
``` 
Dana Ortiz: Network/power/rack constraints to call out in the guide:
Dana Ortiz: - 200G RoCE or 100G + top-of-rack switch with RDMA recommended
Dana Ortiz: - Per-node power: 3.5–4.5 kW depending on PSUs and NVLink bridges
Dana Ortiz: - Rack-level: plan for 20–40 kW per rack (8–12 x A100 nodes)
Dana Ortiz: - Cooling: specify 35–45 kBTU/hr depending on density
Mayra Lopez: For Private deployments we should provide two profiles in the doc: "Cost-optimized" (13B quant + batching) and "Latency/power" (70B quant with more GPUs and dedicated NVLink). Include examples of rollout strategy: start with 13B canary then scale 70B.
InfraBot: capacity-check output: {"us-west": "8", "eu-west": "12", "ap-south": "2"}
Aj Chen: Perfect. I'll draft a short one-page HW guide with:
- Recommended node config (GPU, CPU, memory, NVMe)
- Network & power constraints checklist
- Example capacity calc (include Samir's table)
- Suggested rollout (13B canary -> 70B quant -> fallback to 13B)
Aj Chen: Targeting EOD. If anyone has a quick rack-level sample spec we can paste in, drop it here.
Mayra Lopez: I'll attach a sample spec in comments — 2x A100-80GB per node, 1x dual-socket AMD EPYC 64c, 1.5TB NVMe, 512GB system RAM, 200G NIC + redundant PSUs. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: I'll add the cost model numbers (power, maintenance, expected utilization) to the doc PR.
Aj Chen: Thanks all — will post draft for review in ~3h.
